title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant

£35,000 - £40,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits Hybrid Working Flexible Hours

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Accountant to join a successful international organisation experiencing continued growth.

This role will suit a finance professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is looking to develop their accounting, reconciliation and analytical skills within a large, multi-entity business.

Working as part of an established finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accurate processing, reconciliation and reporting of financial transactions whilst supporting month-end activities and continuous improvement initiatives across the department.

- Flexible working hours
- Hybrid working arrangement

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Our client is looking for a Vehicle Allocation Administrator to join their busy and supportive team on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and customer-focused individual who enjoys working in a fast paced environment and takes pride in delivering outstanding service.

As a Vehicle Allocation Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the allocation and management of hire vehicles for insurance claims. Working closely with branches, suppliers, and customers, you will ensure vehicles are allocated efficiently, supplier service levels are met, and customers receive a seamless experience throughout the process.

This is a varied role that combines administration, customer service, and coordination, making it ideal for someone who enjoys managing multiple priorities and building strong working relationships.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide administrative support for vehicle bookings and allocations across multiple branches.
- Manage inbound and outbound telephone calls in a professional and courteous manner.
- Proactively allocate hire vehicles to claims, ensuring customer needs and claim requirements are met.
- Arrange and confirm vehicle delivery and collection details with customers.
- Work closely with suppliers to ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are achieved.
- Book vehicle delivery and collection appointments through supplier and provider online portals.
- Accurately update claim management systems with customer interactions, actions taken, and claim progress.
- Liaise with branch teams to maximise vehicle availability and allocation opportunities.
- Develop and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues, suppliers, and customers.
- Manage shared inboxes and incoming communications, ensuring prompt responses and resolution of queries.
- Monitor vehicle allocation progress and escalate issues where required.
- Ensure all customer and claim information is recorded accurately and handled in line with company procedures.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Previous administration experience within a busy office environment.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Professional and confident telephone manner.
- Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
- Experience working to deadlines, service levels, and performance targets.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and internal business systems.

If you feel you are suitable for the role we would love to hear from you!

Please note:

As you can appreciate we are currently overwhelmed with applications of individuals looking for both short term and permanent work and we can therefore only contact those applications that have relevant skills for positions that we currently have available. Should you not hear from us within a week, please assume you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

In line with GDPR regulations, we are making you aware that to proceed with your application we will need to contact you via email, telephone and/or text message. To receive future job alerts from us, you will be required to provide consent within our marketing preference options. The link will be provided in an email to you. - Monday-to-Friday working hours.
- The opportunity to contribute to a growing business supporting better recycling.

Apply today with your CV.

title: Project Administrator
description:
Project Administrator

Location: Warrington, WA3 7 WD
Salary: From £25,000 per annum
Contract: Full time, permanent, office based
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8am-5pm

Support an exciting UK rollout and develop your career in purchasing.

Are you an organised administrator who enjoys keeping people, plans and information on track? Join Envipco and develop your skills while supporting our growing UK operation.

About Envipco

Envipco is an international recycling technology business with over 40 years experience developing reverse vending machines that collect drinks containers for recycling.

We are building our UK operation, preparing for the rollout of our machines and the infrastructure needed to support them. Joining now means you can help establish effective working practices and support a growing team, backed by the expertise of an experienced global business.

The opportunity

This permanent position offers variety and a clear next step.

Initially, you will provide administrative and coordination support to our mobilisation programme, with this assignment planned to run until 1 October 2027. As rollout activity reduces, you will transition into a Purchasing Administrator role within our Operations Support team.

Training and practical purchasing experience will be provided during mobilisation to prepare you for this transition.

What you ll receive
- Salary from £25,000 per annum.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Enhanced company pension contribution.
- A family-friendly culture and enhanced leave policies supporting work-life balance.
- Training and experience to develop your purchasing skills.

Your role during the rollout

Working with the Programme Manager and colleagues across Operations, Field Service, HR, Finance and Supply Chain, you will:
- Update schedules, action trackers, calendars and shared records.
- Arrange meetings, prepare agendas and record minutes and actions.
- Follow up deadlines and gather updates for programme reports.
- Maintain accurate, organised and version-controlled documents.
- Support administration for site surveys, installations, deliveries andoperational handovers.
- Coordinate onboarding, training arrangements and equipment requests.
- Help track shipments and stock, highlighting delays or discrepancies.

Your move into purchasing

You will learn our purchasing systems, supplier processes and approval requirements, gradually taking on responsibilities including:
- Processing approved purchase requests and raising accurate purchase orders.
- Obtaining quotations and maintaining supplier and order records.
- Monitoring deliveries and following up outstanding items.
- Liaising with suppliers and colleagues about shortages, returns and order queries.
- Supporting Finance with purchase order, goods receipt and invoice discrepancies.
- Maintaining clear records of orders, approvals and supporting documents.

Throughout both phases, you will also provide general office support, including shared inboxes, meeting arrangements and approved travel and training bookings.

About you

You will have experience in administration, project support or operational coordination, together with:
- Strong organisation, accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confidence using Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook and Teams.
- Experience maintaining records, coordinating meetings and following up actions.
- Clear communication skills and confidence working across teams.
- Good numeracy and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Initiative, discretion and a willingness to develop purchasing skills.

Experience with purchasing, suppliers, logistics or technical environments would be helpful, as would familiarity with Dynamics 365 or Business Central, but these are not essential.

Apply now to develop your career with Envipco.
